name: Witch Doctor Malignant Jinx silences the Jinxed enemy, not the Witch Doctor
contract: Malignant Jinx 803678: 'causing their next spell cast to silence them for 5 sec.' The silence 803732 names
TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, and the class hook cast it as doctor->CastSpell(jinxed, 803732), so the target resolved
to the Witch Doctor: in both final05 runs the doctor carried 803732 and the Jinxed enemy did not (cycle 8
R2 F1). The fix has the Jinxed unit cast 803732 on itself with the Witch Doctor as original caster.
The Jinxed unit is an enemy player (harness creature casts are triggered and the hook skips triggered
casts) that casts a real Renew 25222 (instant, GCD 1500) at itself. Expected: the Renew after the Jinx puts
the Witch Doctor's 803732 on the enemy, its next Renew is refused, and the Witch Doctor carries no 803732
